extracted.intended_audience: people learning German online (beginners to intermediate learners)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and features for learning German online, emphasizing grammar, reading, vocabulary, and conjugation through structured lessons, interactive exercises, and spaced repetition. Aimed at learners starting from scratch or refining fluency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive grammar drills
rubrics_metrics.description: Master German cases, tenses, and sentence structure with clear explanations and interactive exercises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use interactive drills to practice core grammar topics (cases, tenses, sentence structure); the site emphasizes clear explanations paired with exercises. Immediate feedback from exercises is implied by the interactive format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graded real‑world reading texts
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve comprehension with graded texts, from simple dialogues to complex articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a range of reading materials organized by difficulty so learners can progress from simple to complex texts; use real‑world contexts to build comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smart vocabulary training
rubrics_metrics.description: Build your word bank with our smart trainer — learn by topic, frequency, or proficiency level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocabulary practice should be organized by topical lists, word frequency, and learner level to prioritize useful words and support targeted study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive conjugation practice with spaced repetition
rubrics_metrics.description: Train all verb forms across every tense with instant feedback and spaced repetition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full conjugation practice across tenses, provide instant corrective feedback, and use spaced repetition to reinforce long‑term retention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured lessons across core language areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Dive into structured lessons and exercises across four core areas of the German language: Grammar, Reading, Vocabulary, Conjugation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize course content into clear thematic/skill areas so learners can focus on specific competencies; ensure each area contains lessons and practice exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular practice and persistence
rubrics_metrics.description: Mastering elements like cases, noun genders, and verb forms requires time, patience, and regular practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set learner expectations that progress demands consistent effort; encourage routine practice rather than expecting quick mastery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage challenge for motivation and cultural understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: The difficulty of German grammar can make learning interesting and motivating; learning also develops a deeper understanding of culture and communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame challenging aspects of the language as motivating opportunities; integrate cultural/contextual materials to deepen communicative competence and engagement.
